purpose: Document governed Claude/Playwright evidence truth and current StoryEngine browser-federation peer freshness: the claude-code operator identity, Anthropic Messages API runtime, configured read-only MCP attachment, actual correlated MCP tool use, peer rebinding, browser proof, and mutation authority remain separate evidence and authority planes.

claims: `public/_worker.js` must route public static discovery artifacts, including `crawlers.json`, through the Pages `ASSETS` binding while API-owned callback assets remain on `FCR_API`; this routing classification cannot authorize provider mutation or treat a static crawler policy as authentication.

`.github/workflows/playwright.yml` must bind the FCR-to-StoryEngine browser federation witness to a separately verified exact StoryEngine peer SHA and ref; changing that peer identity expires predecessor federation/browser proof and requires the complete exact-head witness to rerun without granting merge, deploy, production, or provider-mutation authority.

A fresh peer ref/SHA observation may select the successor StoryEngine evidence subject, but the successor FCR federation state remains UNKNOWN until the complete exact-head runtime identity, directive, receipt, and Playwright browser witness succeeds against that peer.

Refreshing `STORYENGINE_PEER_SHA` after independently observing StoryEngine main is recovery setup only; pin alignment must not carry predecessor Playwright green or founder approval onto the successor FCR head.

The September 24, 2026 refresh from StoryEngine peer `a5aabd59b4cf515ed7252a44ab10c3f6c1b13b1b` to `35a1855798b4dd059b45f67911280966a09f7be8` was selected only after an independent compare showed the successor seven commits ahead and zero behind with the delta limited to Media Router contract, bridge, tests, and workflow files; the repin is freshness recovery evidence only and leaves successor federation UNKNOWN until exact-head Playwright passes.

The later September 24, 2026 refresh from StoryEngine peer `35a1855798b4dd059b45f67911280966a09f7be8` to independently observed StoryEngine main `dd1521547c81c1a16d9777e1fc254c6bf9c7d6b9` was selected after a compare showed two commits ahead and zero behind limited to resident Council contract changes; this repin selects a new evidence subject only and leaves successor federation UNKNOWN until the exact successor FCR head completes the live-ref equality check, exact peer checkout, runtime identity, directive/receipt binding, and Playwright federation witness.
